room.yard.title: Yard
room.yard.description: A trampled yard. A road runs north.
room.road.title: Road
room.road.description: A dusty road. The yard lies south; a crypt door stands east.
room.crypt.title: Crypt
room.crypt.description: A cold crypt of stacked graves. The road is west.
npc.hal.description: A wiry man with a lantern and a sour look.
npc.bram.description: An old sexton with soil on his hands.
remark.hal.first: Hal mutters that the air down here smells of old bone.
remark.hal.again: Hal says he liked this place no better the first time.
remark.bram.hum: Bram, the sexton, hums over the graves.
dialogue.talk.prompt: Hal waits for you to speak.
